# WK Construction Inc.

> Family-owned construction company in Cleveland, Texas (legal name: Wendell Kelley Construction, Inc.). Over 45 years in business. BBB Accredited since 2004, A+ rated. Builds pre-engineered metal buildings, clears and levels land, pours concrete slabs, and builds custom homes (including log homes), commercial build-outs and renovations in Liberty, Chambers and Hardin counties and nearby towns. One-year warranty on new projects and renovations. Free quotes.

Contact: (281) 592-3792 · (281) 593-5422 · wendellkelley@gmail.com · 195 Bartlett Rd, Cleveland, TX 77328 · Monday to Friday, opens 9:00 AM.

## Home (/)

Built right in East Texas.
Metal buildings, land work, and custom homes around Cleveland, TX. Family owned for over 45 years. Call us and we will come take a look.

We clear the land. We pour the slab. We put up the steel.
Most jobs start with a phone call. Tell us what you want to build and where. We will come out, look at the ground, and give you a straight answer and a written quote.

What we build
- Metal Buildings: Shops, warehouses, and barns in clear-span steel that goes up fast and lasts. Pre-engineered steel buildings for work, storage, and farm use. We handle the slab and the steel, start to finish.
- Site Prep and Land: Clearing, grading, and leveling. A solid start for anything you build. We clear brush and trees, grade the ground, and level it so the building sits flat and water runs away from it.
- Custom Homes: Log homes and custom builds made to be lived in. From the slab to the front porch. We build the home the way you want it, and we keep you in the loop the whole way.
- Commercial Build-Outs: Shops, offices, and store spaces, finished and ready for work. We turn bare space into a working one. Framing, walls, finishes, and the details in between.
- Barns and Farm Buildings: Steel barns for horses, cattle, hay, and equipment. Open-span barns built for animals and machines, sized to your land.
Not sure which one fits? Call us and we will talk it through.

Why folks trust us
- 45+ years in business, family owned
- A+ BBB rating
- 2004 BBB Accredited since
- 1 year warranty on new work and renovations
No BBB complaints in the last three years.

Work you can see
- 01 City of Cleveland Pavilion, Cleveland, TX: We were one of the contractors on the new city pavilion, finished in May 2024. A covered place for the town to gather.
- 02 Metal shops and warehouses: Clear-span steel buildings with big roll-up doors and open floors, sized for how you work.
- 03 Custom log homes: Warm, solid homes built from the slab up. One owner told the BBB they had no failures in their log home, and that is saying a lot.
- 04 Steel barns: Barns for horses, cattle, hay, and equipment on open pasture.

How a job goes
1. We come out: Call or stop by the office. We walk the land with you, hear what you need, and give you a written quote. It is free.
2. We prep the ground: Clearing, grading, and leveling, so the build starts on solid, dry ground.
3. Slab and frame: We pour the concrete slab and put up the frame, steel or wood.
4. Finish and hand over: We finish the job, walk it with you, and stand behind it with a one-year warranty on new work.

"I can honestly say that we have not had any failures in the construction of our home and that is saying a lot for a log home!"
Ann B., BBB customer review

Where we work
We work in Liberty, Chambers, and Hardin counties, and in Cleveland, Plum Grove, Humble, Dayton, Crosby, and Shepherd. Not sure if you are in range? Call us.

Questions we get a lot
- Do you give free quotes? Yes. Call us or stop by during office hours and we will set up a time to look at the job. You get a written quote after that.
- Do you do the land work and the slab too? Yes. We clear, grade, level, and pour the slab, so one crew can take a job from bare ground to a finished building.
- What kinds of metal buildings do you put up? Shops, warehouses, barns, and commercial buildings. Clear-span steel in a size that fits your work.
- Do you build log homes? Yes. We build custom homes, including log homes.
- Is there a warranty? We give a one-year warranty on new projects and renovations. HVAC units and appliances carry the manufacturer's warranty.
- Where do you work? Liberty, Chambers, and Hardin counties, and the towns of Cleveland, Plum Grove, Humble, Dayton, Crosby, and Shepherd.

## Metal Buildings (/metal-buildings/)

Metal buildings, built start to finish.
Shops, warehouses, barns, and commercial buildings. We pour the slab and put up the steel.

Steel that fits your work
A good steel building starts with how you will use it. Tell us what goes inside, and we will size it to match.
- Shops and warehouses: Wide open floors with no posts in the way. Move trucks, stock, and machines the way you need to.
- Farm and ranch buildings: Barns, hay storage, and equipment sheds. Built tough for weather, animals, and heavy use.
- Commercial buildings: Storefronts, offices, and light industrial space in steel, ready for the next step.
- Clear-span frames: No columns inside the span. More usable floor, easier to lay out, and easier to change later.

Inside and out
- Outside: steel panels, roll-up doors, room to pull a truck in.
- Inside: a clear span and a clean concrete floor.
- On the farm: an open barn for animals and equipment.

One crew, one job
Site walk and written quote. Land clearing and grading. Concrete slab. Steel frame and panels. Doors, windows, and insulation options. Final walk-through and a one-year warranty.

Questions
- How long does a metal building take? It depends on the size, the ground, and the permits. We give you a timeline in the written quote.
- Can you build on my land? Yes. We work in Liberty, Chambers, and Hardin counties and the towns around Cleveland. If the lot needs clearing or leveling, we do that too.
- Can I get a building for my farm? Yes. Barns, hay storage, and equipment buildings are some of the buildings we put up most.

## Site Prep and Land (/site-prep-and-land/)

Solid ground first.
Land clearing, grading, leveling, and concrete slabs in Liberty, Chambers, and Hardin counties.

Four steps to a build-ready lot
1. Clearing: We take out brush, trees, and stumps so you can see what you have to work with.
2. Grading: We shape the ground so water runs away from where you will build.
3. Leveling: A flat, packed pad is the base for every building. We do not rush it.
4. Concrete slab: We set the forms and rebar, then pour the concrete.

Same lot, a few months apart
Raw land on one side. A finished building on the other.

The slab matters most
Cracks and settling start at the base. We form it right, set the rebar, and pour it to hold.

Questions
- How long does land clearing take? It depends on how thick the brush is and how big the lot is. We give you a timeline when we see the land.
- Will you build on the land after you clear it? Yes. We can clear, grade, pour the slab, and build, all with the same crew.
- Do you work outside Cleveland? Yes. Liberty, Chambers, and Hardin counties, plus Plum Grove, Humble, Dayton, Crosby, and Shepherd.

## Custom Construction (/custom-construction/)

Homes and spaces built to be used.
Custom homes, log homes, commercial build-outs, and renovations, built by one family-owned crew.

Custom homes
We build custom homes, including log homes. You tell us how you live, and we build around that. From the slab to the front porch, you know what is happening on your job.

"I can honestly say that we have not had any failures in the construction of our home and that is saying a lot for a log home!"
Ann B., BBB customer review

Commercial build-outs
Empty space is only the start. We frame it, finish it, and hand it back ready to open.

Renovations
- Repairs: Structural fixes done right, so you do not fix them twice.
- Additions: More room, built to match what you already have.
- Updates: Inside and out, from a single room to the whole building.
Every renovation comes with a one-year warranty.

What you can count on
- Reliable: We show up when we say we will.
- Clear talk: You know what is happening on your job.
- Honest: If something changes, you hear it from us first.
- Built to last: We build it right, and we fix what is not.

Questions
- Do you build log homes? Yes. Custom homes, including log homes, are some of our favorite jobs.
- Can you finish out a commercial space? Yes. We frame, finish, and hand over the space ready to use.
- Do renovations have a warranty? Yes. New projects and renovations both come with a one-year warranty. HVAC units and appliances carry the manufacturer's warranty.
